'''Din Grogu''', known only as '''Grogu''' until being formally adopted by [[Din Djarin]] after the [[Liberation of Mandalore]], was a [[Gender|male]] [[Force-sensitive]] [[Mandalorian]] belonging to the same [[Yoda's species|mysterious species]] as the legendary [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]]. Grogu was [[Reproduction|born]] around the year [[41 BBY]], and was raised at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] as a [[Jedi Initiate]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. Grogu had survived the [[Great Jedi Purge]] and was hidden away. Years later, he was rediscovered by a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] after it [[Battle of Jakku|fell]] and led by [[Gideon|Moff Gideon]]. At this point, Grogu became known to many simply as '''the Child''', during the [[New Republic Era]]. However, Grogu was rescued by [[Din Djarin]], a Mandalorian [[bounty hunter]] where he became a [[foundling]]. Sharing many adventures together, Djarin was eventually able to find a [[Jedi]] to train Grogu and he rejoined the Jedi Order under [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. Later on though, Skywalker sensed that Grogu's heart was not in learning the Jedi path, thus he subsequently gave in to his attachment to the Mandalorian and was returned to him upon which he would start to train to become a Mandalorian himself.

Grogu was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[41 BBY]] and was raised at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] as a [[Jedi Initiate]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. At one point, Grogu encountered a group of [[Dust bunny|dust bunnies]] that gathered around him and offered him a [[flower]], which he accepted. With the [[Order 66|beginning]] of the Jedi Purge and [[Proclamation of the New Order|dawn]] of the [[Imperial Era]], he was taken into hiding by Jedi Master [[Kelleran Beq]]. Eventually, he was held at a [[Nikto hideout|hideout]] run by [[Nikto]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] on [[Arvala-7]] during the era of the [[New Republic]], having survived the [[Operation: Knightfall|siege of the Jedi Temple]] [[Standard decade|decades]] prior. While still an infant at the age of fifty [[Standard year|years]], he was [[Hunt for Grogu|sought]] by the "[[the Client]]," on behalf of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] and [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]], by an [[The Client|Imperial client]] who hired Djarin to [[Mission to Arvala-7|retrieve]] him.

However, Djarin chose not to leave Grogu with the remnant and rescued him from the [[Imperial Remnant safe house]]. After attempting to hide with Grogu along the fringes of [[the galaxy]], Djarin returned to [[Nevarro]] to deal with the Imperials chasing Grogu in hopes of keeping him safe. In the process, Grogu became a Mandalorian foundling and the single other member of [[Clan Mudhorn|Djarin's newly created clan]]. As a result, Djarin took up a quest to deliver Grogu back to the Jedi. Djarin, alongside Grogu, would then travel across the [[galaxy]], searching for the few remaining Jedi who were left. As advised by former Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano]], Djarin would eventually travel with Grogu to [[Tython]], where he could reach out through [[the Force]] to find another member of his kind. However, Grogu was [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|captured]] by Imperial forces, and Djarin was forced to lead a mission to [[Assault on Moff Gideon's cruiser|rescue]] him. After being reunited with Grogu, Djarin delivered him to [[Luke Skywalker]], a Jedi who agreed to take the child into his care and [[Jedi training|train]] him in the ways of the Force.

Grogu renewed his training under Skywalker and spent a relatively short period training with Skywalker on [[Ossus]], where Skywalker was building a [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi Academy]]. However, Skywalker sensed that the child's [[heart]] was not in learning the Jedi path. After Djarin visited the [[planet]] bearing a gift of [[Grogu's chainmail shirt|chain mail armor]] for Grogu, Skywalker presented the child with a choice: accepting the gift and returning to the Mandalorian, or taking [[Yoda's second lightsaber|Yoda's lightsaber]] and continue with his Jedi training. Grogu chose to return to Djarin and was reunited with him on [[Tatooine]] in the middle of a [[War against the Pykes|gang war]] between [[Boba Fett]]'s [[Fett gotra|forces]], whom Djarin was aiding, and the [[Pyke Syndicate]].

Afterward, he and Djarin would travel the galaxy in hopes of restoring their home planet [[Mandalore]], and the people as well. With the aid of [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the [[Children of the Watch]] working together, they were able to establish an alliance with the with other [[Mandalorian]]s in retaking their home planet, only to discover in horror that it was being occupied by Imperial remnants lead by non other than [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. Working together, Grogu and the Mandalorians defeated Moff Gideon. With this, the Mandalorians reclaimed their homeworld and Grogu would go on to be adopted by Din Djarin. The two continued their adventures together.

[[Standard year|Years]] later, the two worked with the [[Anzellan Droidsmiths]] to [[Mission to Nevarro's lava tubes|recover]] warheads under the surface of Nevarro. Grogu later assisted Djarin in [[Attack on Barro's Imperial remnant|hunting]] Imperial [[warlord]] [[Barro]] on [[Phostera]], using the Force to help Djarin before accompanying him to [[Shakari]] to rescue [[Rotta]] the [[Hutt]], on behalf of the [[New Republic]]. Grogu befriended Rotta and helped Djarin uncover that [[crime lord]] [[Janu Coin|Janu]] was actually Imperial fugitive [[Commander]] Coin. After [[Embo]] [[Ambush on the Clan Mudhorn cabin|captured]] Djarin and the [[Anzellan]] [[Droidsmith]] [[Minch]], Grogu escaped with the Anzellans and helped [[Rescue of Din Djarin|rescue]] the two from the [[The Twins|Hutt Twins]]. When Djarin was [[poison]]ed by a [[dragonsnake]], Grogu cared for him and obtained an [[Dragonsnake venom antidote|antidote]] from the [[Fisher|fisherman]] [[Gatori]], saving his life. Grogu later accompanied Djarin in rescuing Rotta from the [[Hutt Palace]], using the Force to calm [[Keibu]] and save Rotta during the palace's [[Battle of Nal Hutta (Din Djarin)|destruction]]. After Rotta joined the New Republic, Grogu departed with Djarin aboard the ''[[Razor Crest 2.0]]'' and was allowed to initiate the jump to hyperspace.
